Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production source sprite sheet for Vibespire.
Primary request: EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows of separate physical game objects, row-major positions below. new.name: Guilt
new.text: Scrap. (Does nothing.)

new.text: Gain {block} Block. Add {add_card} Chaff to your hand.

new.name: Grim Harvest
new.text: Keep. Harvest {harvest}.
new.concept: A skull-faced mushroom cap being sliced open, purple rot pouring out like grain.

new.concept: A row of stumps cut flat, wood chips flying, an axe-like claw above them.

new.name: Chaff
new.text: Gain {block} Block. Scrap.
new.concept: A loose pale-yellow tuft of dry husks and stalk fragments.

new.name: Jitter
new.text: Scrap. The next card you play this turn costs {tax} more.
new.concept: A damaged spring-driven metal escapement with a loose vibrating silver balance arm and red spark.

new.name: Backlash
new.text: Unplayable. If held at the end of your turn, it is primed for free: the next enemy hit on you deals +{extra_damage} damage. Then Scrap it.
new.concept: A recoiling broken steel spring striking the back of a battered metal gauntlet.

new.name: Tangle
new.text: While this is in your hand, the cards directly left and right of it cost {tax} more.
new.concept: Two worn grey card-shaped metal plates tightly caught in a thick green thorn root knot.

new.name: Drift
new.text: Scrap. If this is in your hand at the end of your turn, you have {energy_loss} less energy next turn (then Scrap it).
new.concept: A small brass energy cell drifting out of a fractured silver socket on a severed dark hose.

new.name: Spare Fuse
new.text: At the start of each combat, add a Fuse to your hand.
new.concept: A short copper cartridge fuse with a glowing orange filament inside its glass window.

new.name: Antenna Wire
new.text: Whenever you play a Power, draw {draw} card.
new.concept: A coil of silver wire wound around a small whip antenna, a cyan signal tick at the tip.

new.name: Slag Bucket
new.text: The first time you Shed Guard each turn, draw {draw} card.
new.concept: An iron bucket brimming with glowing orange slag, a gold plate edge sticking out.

new.name: Storm Lantern
new.text: Whenever you apply Goad, apply {goad} more.
new.concept: A brass ship's lantern with a tiny grey storm cloud and lightning trapped inside the glass.

new.name: Scar Engine
new.text: Whenever you Strain, apply {status} Exposed to ALL enemies.
new.concept: A small red piston engine with stitched-scar seams along its casing, a crack of white light at one seam.

new.name: Static Choir
new.text: Whenever a Status card is Scrapped, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.
new.concept: Three tiny tuning-fork pylons with yellow static arcs jumping between them.

new.name: Whetstone
new.text: Whenever you apply Exposed to an enemy, apply {exposed} more.
new.concept: A grey sharpening stone with a bright blade edge sliding across it, a spark at the contact.

new.name: Ash Wick

new.concept: A candle stub whose wick burns with three tiny flames stacked one above another.

new.name: Overture Engine

new.concept: A brass music-box cylinder with a gold pin raised, a glowing card rising from its lid.

new.name: Blood Rivets
new.text: Whenever you Strain, gain Guard equal to {mult} times the HP you lost.
new.concept: Three steel rivets set in a gold plate, each with a drop of red at its head.

new.name: Blood Mulch
new.text: The first time you Strain each turn, a random Bloom card in your hand, draw pile or discard pile gains {bloom} Bloom.
new.concept: A clay pot of dark soil with a green shoot rising from a red-stained patch.

new.name: Borrowed Time
new.text: Whenever you Strain, Advance {advance}.
new.concept: A cracked hourglass whose falling sand is red instead of gold.

new.name: Coal Scuttle
new.text: At the start of each combat, gain {status} Ember.
new.concept: A small black coal scuttle with one glowing ember on top.

new.name: Husk Sac
new.text: The first time you Prune each turn, add a Chaff to your hand.
new.concept: A papery pale-yellow seed sac bulging with dry husks, tied at the neck with a vine.

new.name: Reaper's Sickle
new.text: Whenever you Harvest, gain Block equal to {pct}% of the HP the enemy lost (round down).
new.concept: A small bone-handled sickle with a purple-green rot drip on its blade.

new.name: Astrolabe
new.text: The first time each turn {batch} or more cards resolve together from your Timeline, gain {energy} energy.
new.concept: A brass astrolabe with three rings aligned in a row, a gold star where they cross.

new.name: Reserve Coil
new.text: At the end of your turn, your unspent energy goes into Reserve.
new.concept: A squat copper capacitor coil with a blue charge-level bar half full on its side.

new.name: Echo Bell
new.text: The first time each turn you play the last card in your hand, it has Reprise.
new.concept: A small silver handbell with two faint ghost outlines of itself ringing beside it.

new.name: Kickback Governor

new.concept: A brass spinning governor with two weights, a red arrow bouncing off it back the way it came.

new.name: Orbital Hammer

new.concept: A heavy warhammer head with a tiny ring of orbiting lights around it.

new.name: Momentum Flywheel
new.text: Each X-cost Attack you play gives Onslaught equal to its X.
new.concept: A spoked iron flywheel spinning, red chevron motion marks trailing it.

new.name: Refrain Pin
new.text: The first card you play on the beat each turn has Reprise.
new.concept: A gold brooch shaped like a repeat sign (two dots and a double bar).

new.name: Twin Scabbard
new.text: Whenever a primed card fires, add a random Riposte card from your class to your hand. It is gone after combat.
new.concept: A leather scabbard holding two crossed sword hilts.

new.name: Recoil Coil
new.text: Whenever an enemy's attack is cancelled or it skips a move, gain {energy} energy next turn.
new.concept: A compressed steel spring with a blue energy spark at its tip.

new.name: Trellis
new.text: At the start of your turn, put a Ripe card from your discard pile into your hand.
new.concept: A small wooden lattice with one gold-leafed vine climbing it.

new.name: Festering Lens
new.text: When an enemy's Rot ticks, it loses {per} more HP for each Exposed it has.
new.concept: A round monocle lens with a cracked purple-green rot bloom seen through the glass.

new.name: Conductor's Baton
new.text: Your Crescendo effects count {beats} more beat.
new.concept: A white conductor's baton with a gold tip and three small music-note sparks.

new.concept: A green field-medic locker with two compartments lit and the rest of its drawers smoking.

new.name: Wanderer's Compact
new.text: +{energy} energy each turn. Card rewards offer one card from each class instead of cards from yours.
new.concept: A worn leather wallet-compass with three coloured pins (red, green, blue) on its dial.

new.name: Furnace Mantle
new.text: +{energy} energy each turn. At the start of your turn, Shed all your Guard instead of halving it.
new.concept: A gold shoulder mantle glowing red-hot at the edges, plates peeling off as sparks.

new.name: Perpetual Calendar
new.text: +{energy} energy each turn. Cards that resolve from your Timeline go to the bottom of your draw pile instead of your discard pile.
new.concept: A brass desk calendar with a loop arrow around its dial of turning pages.

new.name: Salvager's Licence

new.concept: A small stamped metal tag on a chain with a gear-and-wrench emblem.

new.name: Blood Ampoule
new.text: Strain {strain}. Gain {energy} energy.
new.concept: A thin glass ampoule of bright red liquid with a yellow lightning-bolt label.

new.name: Surge Flask
new.text: Gain {status} Reserve.
new.concept: A squat flask of crackling electric-blue liquid with a battery-style cap.

new.name: Kiln Salts

new.concept: A small corked jar of glowing orange-white crystals, wisps of smoke rising.

new.name: Fracture Serum
new.text: Double the Exposed on ALL enemies.
new.concept: A round flask of pale liquid with a white crack pattern etched across the glass.

new.name: Riposte Salts
new.text: Prime up to {prime} Riposte cards from your hand now, beyond your capacity.

new.name: Ember Tonic

new.concept: A dark bottle with a single glowing coal floating in amber liquid.

new.name: Fester Draught
new.text: Double the Rot on an enemy.
new.concept: A murky purple-green vial bubbling, a tiny rot skull on the label.

new.name: Hourglass Tonic
new.text: Gather, then Advance {advance}.
new.concept: An hourglass-shaped vial with gold sand pooled in one bulb.

new.name: Echo Draught
new.text: Your next card this turn has Reprise.
new.concept: A tall cyan flask whose liquid shows a doubled ghost image of the bottle.

new.concept: A wobbling green gel blob in a beaker with two little copies of itself budding off.
